headline:
A $1 billion project
in Davie renamed itself.
[[Right after topping out.]]
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
deck: The District at Davie is now The Plaza Davie District. The first tower just topped out at 22 stories, 288 units in Phase One alone.
takeaway: Developers do not rebrand a project they expect to stall. This is a bet the timeline holds.
